expectedUsable: A keyboard or screen-reader user who opens the newsletter modal can dismiss it (Escape and an operable close button) and move focus back to the page.

violations.expectedFix: Allow dismissal without a trap: handle the Escape key to close, and let focus return to the invoking control (#open-modal). The focus trap itself is acceptable ONLY if a working keyboard exit exists.
violations.notes: Tab is force-cycled inside the dialog with no branch returning focus to the page; there is no keydown handler for Escape. axe cannot see JS focus behavior, so the page reports zero violations.

violations.expectedFix: Make the close control a real <button> (focusable, activatable by Enter/Space) with an accessible name such as "Close dialog", instead of a click-only <span>.
violations.notes: The only close affordance is a <span> with an onclick handler: not in the tab order and not keyboard-activatable. The dialog itself has valid role/aria-modal/aria-labelledby, so axe passes.
